items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I became friendly with a good piano player in Copenhagen named Ben Fabricious

ctx.x: Yes, right -- to Miss, what was her name? But she threw him out after awhile, or he threw her out, one of the two.

But at any rate, that type of novelty can cut through at any time, and just capture the public like that. Like sometimes I have become -- I became friendly with a good piano player in Copenhagen named Ben Fabricious; this guy was a good studio man over there and they needed a little piece of music for a radio show or a TV show in Copenhagen, and he knocked off this little thing, 'Alley Cat.' That thing swept the world, and he laughed! He's had me home to dinner in Copenhagen.
Was he the guy that wrote that?
